data.name: Dharmpal
data.gender_notes: Dharmpal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dharmpal is derived from Sanskrit words 'Dharma' and 'Pal'. Dharma represents righteousness, morality, and duty, while Pal means protector. Therefore, Dharmpal is a name for someone who upholds righteousness and protects it. The name Dharmpal carries the meaning “Dharma (righteousness) + Pal (protector)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharmpal usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma (righteousness) + pal (protector) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the protection of righteousness and dharma in one's life.
data.etymology: Dharmpal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma (righteousness) + Pal (protector).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharmpal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
